added.rake: house rake withheld from each settled pot, added additively to HandResult

economics.measured_over: 20000 seeded hands driving the real deal and settlement
economics.always_play_rtp: ~100.0% (break-even; one of four equal contributors splitting by best hand, human may only call or fold)
economics.post_rake_best_play_rtp: ~98% (house-side with margin without over-penalizing straightforward play)

settlement.pot_distribution: winners split the post-rake pot; the raked cents stay debited as the house edge
settlement.solvency: credits never exceed debits; the withheld rake is the only net wallet reduction
